title: PersonaPlex + Qwen3-TTS Voice Server
description: Dual GPU voice AI server: PersonaPlex (Moshi) for real-time voice conversations via WebSocket, and Qwen3-TTS for multilingual voice cloning with ~208ms first-chunk latency. Supports 10 languages with In-Context Learning.

input.name: Enable torch.compile
input.description: Enable torch.compile streaming optimizations (true/false). Increases startup time but reduces inference latency.

input.name: Decode Window Frames
input.description: Number of frames per decode window for streaming TTS
